title: The deploy keys stay repository secrets
quote: Keep DEPLOY_SSH_KEY and DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS where they are.
means: The deploy's two secrets stay repository secrets instead of moving into the environment production. The risk is accepted and written into AIP-5's assumptions: a workflow on any branch could read them.

reflection.checked: every decision before D-71 that held
reflection.result: supersedes nothing; the move into the environment was only proposed in AIP-5's revision 2
